name: release-assurance
description: Plan, verify, publish, and retire software releases with explicit gates and post-release evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Gate releases and verify published artifacts.
interface.longDescription: Plan bounded releases, verify candidates and built artifacts, publish only with explicit authority, prove each destination from the consumer side, and retire superseded projects without losing provenance or recovery paths.
defaultPrompt: Plan a bounded release with explicit gates.
Publish this approved release and prove it works.
